title: Choose what to translate
subtitle: Unchecked categories are skipped. If you haven't touched anything, the defaults are safe.

recommend.line: About {{cost}} with {{model}} via OpenRouter — apply it in translation settings

blacklist.hint: Libraries, optimization mods and author tooling are excluded by default — only the pack author ever reads their text. Matching is by mod id, and excluding a mod never removes translations it already ships.

hardcoded.header: Text no language file can reach
hardcoded.summary: {{mods}} mods hardcode {{strings}} display strings in their code
hardcoded.hint: These mods build the text in Java instead of reading it from a language file, so the game never looks up a translation for it. No tool that edits language files can change it — not moru, not a hand translation, not a resource pack. It stays English, and that is not a translation failure. Fixing it needs a Mixin shipped as a companion mod; a resource pack cannot carry code.

overrides.summary: Enabled resource packs replaced {{keys}} source strings — the text players actually see is what gets translated

community.summaryCompatible: A translation published for {{version}} is marked compatible
community.uncovered: At least {{uncovered}} of this modpack's {{local}} entries are not in it — those still get translated
community.covered: Comparing entry counts per category found nothing missing
community.unmeasured: How much of this modpack it covers could not be measured
community.reuseReady: Downloading it attaches it to your previous-version modpack, and every entry whose English text is unchanged is reused instead of retranslated.
community.needsPrevious: Reusing this needs the modpack folder of the version you translated before. A downloaded pack holds Korean text but no record of the English it was translated from, so without it there is no way to tell which lines are still current — and applying a stale one silently would be worse than translating it again.
community.sameVersionHint: This pack was built for the version you have. Pick your previous modpack to reuse it with the source text verified, or reuse it as the same version below — that skips the check, so a mod updated since the pack was published would keep its old translation.
community.attached: Attached. The reuse count above is measured against the entries actually matched.
community.failed: Could not download the pack. Nothing has changed; the run can continue without it.

migration.title: Previous translation compared
migration.summary: Reuse {{reused}} previous manual translations and translate only {{translate}} entries.
migration.zero: No exact matches were found; all entries will follow the normal translation path.
